title: Rosemary Beach: Vista Verde Carriage House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Vista Verde Carriage House in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Wonderful Rosemary Getaway for a couple. A charming carriage house one block from the Rosemary Beach town center. The decor and open floor plan are perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach or an evening out at one of the many wonderful restaurants located just a short walk from your cottage.

The modern and well-equipped kitchen has plenty of quartz counter space, stainless appliances, dishwasher and washer/dryer. Adjoining the kitchen is a cozy dining area.There is plenty of space to relax in the separate living area, featuring comfortable seating, while watching that perfect movie on the 40" flat screen TV, reading that favorite book you have been saving for your trip, or simply catching-up on the days activities.

The spacious sleeping area includes a king bed with separate lighting on both sides of the bed for nighttime reading. This en suite concept features a spacious master bath and larger walk-in shower. There is also plenty of space to hang/store all of your belongings.

This is the perfect carriage house having beautiful natural light and a walk out balcony. To further enhance your privacy the entrance is separate from the main house allowing direct access throughout your visit. The HVAC unit and water supply is equipped with a germicidal UV lamp. Please be advised that we only allow a maximum of 2 adults.

Included with the rental are 2 adult bikes. This studio is located on the second level above garage.
